apps/ios/Sources/Editor/Toolbar/EditorTo.why: the keyboard accessory's items, labelled from ToolbarSpec (generated from packages/editor/src/toolbar.ts); each is an editor verb

apps/ios/Sources/Editor/Toolbar/ToolbarC.why: the keyboard's dismiss capsule (ToolbarIconButton), labelled from ToolbarSpec.dismiss: DismissKeyboard, the editor's from its web view and Feedback's from FeedbackView

apps/ios/Sources/Notes/List/DestructiveC.why: the destructive button, labelled by the catalog key its caller passes (Delete note, Delete folder), which ConfirmDialog claims

apps/ios/Sources/Notes/List/NoteListView.why: the search results, labelled by their note's name (OpenNote, by note=)

apps/ios/Sources/Notes/List/FolderConten.why: folder and note rows, labelled by their names (OpenFolder and OpenNote, by folder= and note=)

apps/ios/Sources/Notes/List/MoveFolderSh.why: the folder rows, labelled by their paths (PickFolder, by folder=)

apps/ios/Sources/Notes/List/MoveToFolder.why: the folder rows, labelled by their paths (PickFolder, by folder=)

apps/ios/Sources/License/LicenseSettings.why: the plate's filled, outlined and text buttons, each labelled from its action (copyPath): BuyLicense (filled), BuyLicenseInAppStore (outlined), StartLicenseEntry, RestorePurchases, OpenLostKeyHelp and RemoveLicense (text)

apps/ios/Sources/License/LicenseBuyPair..why: the pair's two buttons, labelled by the title each caller's Choice carries: BuyLicense and BuyLicenseInAppStore

apps/ios/Sources/Sync/Hosted/HostedSyncS.why: the refused-write banner's button, labelled by the banner: Subscribe (Sync paused) or ManageSubscription (Vault full)

apps/ios/Sources/Sync/Hosted/ShowPairing.why: the show-a-code button, labelled for the state (a code, or a new one): ShowPairingCode

apps/ios/Sources/Sync/Hosted/UnlockStepV.why: the three unlock-method buttons, each labelled from its method (sync.hosted.unlock.doors.*): SelectUnlockMethod

apps/ios/Sources/Notes/List/NoteSortMenu.why: the system sort menu's key and direction rows, each labelled from NoteSortPreference; reached by real touch, no verb

apps/ios/Sources/Settings/AppIcon/AppIco.why: the license ask's filled, outlined, secondary and link buttons, each labelled by its caller's catalog path (BuyLicense, BuyLicenseInAppStore, StartLicenseEntry, DismissDialog)

apps/ios/Sources/Settings/SettingsView.s.why: the app icon row, labelled with the chosen icon's name: OpenAppIcons

noControl.ios:DismissDialog: the license ask's Not now, a button labelled through its helper (counted under computed)
noControl.ios:OpenNote: a note row, labelled by the note's title; futo-puppet pairs it by the row's note=
noControl.ios:OpenFolder: a folder row, labelled by its name; futo-puppet pairs it by the row's folder=
noControl.ios:SetSearchQuery: the list's .searchable field, which SwiftUI draws itself
noControl.ios:ClearSearchQuery: the .searchable field's own clear button, which SwiftUI draws itself
noControl.ios:SetFeedbackMessage: the message field is a UIKit text view (FeedbackMessageField) with its placeholder drawn over it
noControl.ios:RemoveFeedbackAttachment: each screenshot's remove button, labelled with its number (feedback.removeScreenshot takes it)
noControl.ios:ShowLicenseKey: a tap on the masked key, a gesture on its text with license.card.revealKey as its accessibility label, not a Button
noControl.ios:BuyLicense: one of the license plate's action buttons, labelled from its action (counted under computed)
noControl.ios:StartLicenseEntry: the app icon ask's I already paid, a button labelled by its caller's catalog path (counted under computed)
noControl.ios:OpenLostKeyHelp: one of the license plate's action buttons, labelled from its action (counted under computed)
noControl.ios:RemoveLicense: one of the license plate's action buttons, labelled from its action (counted under computed)
noControl.ios:BuyLicenseInAppStore: the license plate's Buy in App Store and the app icon ask's, labelled from its action or its caller's catalog path (counted under computed)
noControl.ios:RestorePurchases: one of the license plate's action buttons, labelled from its action (counted under computed)
noControl.ios:SpinCoin: a tap on the supporter coin, a 3D view with no label
noControl.ios:CloseScanner: the scanner screen's Back, the navigation bar's own button
noControl.ios:ScanPairingCode: the camera reading a pairing code; the verb takes the string it would have read
noControl.ios:ShowPairingCode: the show-a-code button, labelled for the state (counted under computed)
noControl.ios:SelectUnlockMethod: the three unlock-method buttons are labelled from the method's name, so no one key names them
noControl.ios:DismissKeyboard: the keyboard's dismiss capsule, labelled from ToolbarSpec (counted under computed in ToolbarControls.swift)
noControl.ios:ConfirmDialog: DestructiveConfirmDialog's ConfirmDialog claims the key its caller passes (Delete note, Delete folder), which this check, reading only quoted keys, cannot see
noControl.ios:SelectAppIcon: an icon button, labelled with the icon's name
noControl.ios:OpenAppIcons: the app icon row, labelled with the chosen icon's name

unclaimed.ios:notes.actions.share: hands the note to the OS share sheet; the app does nothing more
unclaimed.ios:notes.actions.moreAccessibilityLabel: opens the ⋯ menu, a system Menu: a tap on ⋯, then on an item
unclaimed.ios:editor.find.open: an item of the editor's ⋯ menu, a system Menu reached by real touch; the find bar it opens has SetFindQuery, StepFind and CloseFind
unclaimed.ios:notes.actions.moveToFolderEllipsis: an item of the ⋯ menu and of a note row's long-press menu, system menus reached by real touch; the sheet it opens has PickFolder and DismissDialog
unclaimed.ios:notes.actions.copyFilePath: an item of the editor's ⋯ menu, a system Menu reached by real touch
unclaimed.ios:notes.actions.deleteNote: an item of the editor's ⋯ menu, a system Menu reached by real touch; the confirmation it opens has ConfirmDialog and DismissDialog
unclaimed.ios:common.actions.delete: a note row's swipe action and long-press menu item, system UI reached by real touch; the confirmation has ConfirmDialog and DismissDialog
unclaimed.ios:common.actions.move: a note row's swipe action, system UI reached by real touch; the sheet it opens has PickFolder and DismissDialog
unclaimed.ios:folders.actions.deleteFolderEllipsis: a folder row's swipe action and long-press menu item, system UI reached by real touch; the confirmation has ConfirmDialog and DismissDialog
unclaimed.ios:folders.actions.moveToFolderEllipsis: a folder row's long-press menu item, a system menu reached by real touch; the sheet it opens has PickFolder and DismissDialog
unclaimed.ios:notes.sort.heading: the Sort by button, a system Menu opened with a real tap
unclaimed.ios:settings.appIcon.license.a11yInclude: a coined icon tile's label, with the icon's name in it: SelectAppIcon
unclaimed.ios:feedback.removeScreenshot: RemoveFeedbackAttachment, whose label takes the screenshot's number
